name: jeroen blokland
zh_summary: 美國通脹仍然過高，並預期持續如此。亞特蘭大聯儲粘性價格通脹為2.8%，低於頭條3.7%，遠低於2022年末的6.7%。金融條件自八月收緊，可能讓聯儲避免額外加息。預期通脹約3%成為新常態；若降至2.8%將允許聯儲停止加息週期。
text:
US inflation remains too high.

And I expect it to stay that way.

But underlying inflation looks less alarming. According to the Atlanta Fed, sticky-price inflation, which measures prices that change relatively infrequently, runs well below headline inflation: 2.8% versus 3.7%.

In late 2022, "sticky" prices were rising at a 6.7% annual rate.

With financial conditions already tightening since August, this could give the Federal Reserve a way out of several additional rate hikes.

An October rate hike is not really on the table, but it will be interesting to see whether Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who rarely gives much away at FOMC press conferences, acknowledges any of this.

I believe inflation around 3% will become the new normal.

And if headline inflation falls from today's 3.7% to, say, 2.8%, matching sticky-price inflation, I expect both investors and the Fed to celebrate.

Not because inflation has been defeated. But because it would give the Fed a chance to halt its rate-hiking cycle.

At that point, the Fed may be ready to declare victory at 3% inflation and leave markets alone. But your purchasing power won't be celebrating just yet.

name: Serenity
zh_summary: 公眾對$MSFT退出NScale交易的解讀有誤。這對擁有已通電容量並與微軟合作的Neocloud如$NBIS或$IREN是利好。微軟急需供應；NScale因英國電網限制延遲，意味著他們會另尋來源，使其他供應商更有價值。取消交易警告執行風險，但有利競爭對手。
text:
Feels like the public interpretation is all wrong… 

I’m pretty sure $MSFT backing out on NScale deal is bullish for Neoclouds like $NBIS or even $IREN with energized capacity with Microsoft?

Pretend Microsoft just ate a bunch of Chipotle burittos:

- They order toilet paper delivery scheduled Q1 2027

- NScale says: sorry 3-4+ year delay of the toilet paper (into 2030’s) because of UK grid constraints

- Microsoft still urgently needs toilet paper so they will get it elsewhere

The cancellation does send warnings about what happens if a Neocloud can’t execute on contracted demand.

But that just makes the other toilet paper sellers more valuable since Microsoft will go elsewhere for supply.

zh_summary: 美國股市週一反彈（SPX +0.5%，NDX +1.1%），本週$META、$NFLX及$TSLA財報前，晶片股在SOX連續九個交易日跌17%後回升。布倫特原油跌2.4%至$107，10年期國債收益率升至5.08%。$TSLA上漲0.4%。2026年標普EPS $367（年增32%）對應21.1倍市盈率即4.7%盈利收益率，相對10年期收益率仍倒掛。預期伊朗戰爭結束後長期利率回落。對$TSLA保持謹慎，因估值偏高（2026年230倍市盈率對比45%長期增長），自動駕駛技術持續商品化。
text: U.S. stocks rebounded Monday (SPX +0.5%, NDX +1.1%) ahead of $META, $NFLX, and $TSLA earnings this week, lifting chip stocks after SOX’s -17% nine-session skid (longest since 2006). Brent fell -2.4% to $107, the 10-year TY rose to 5.08%, and #BTC, gold, and silver all moved higher. $TSLA edged up +0.4% after investors expressed indifference to the Roadster unveil (limited earnings impact) and awaited a $SPCX-$TSLA all-stock merger announcement. 2026 S&P EPS of $367 (+32% YoY) implies a 21.1x P/E = 4.7% earnings yield which remains inverted vs 10-yr treasury yields, last seen in the 1999-2000 dot-com era. I expect long rates to ease as the Iran war ends. I remain cautious on $TSLA due to its stretched hvaluation (230x 2026 P/E vs +45% future long-term earnings growth) as autonomous tech continues to commoditize.
